label: Stephen King — The Gunslinger magazine stories
description: Five Dark Tower stories first published in The Magazine of Fantasy and Science Fiction from October 1978 through November 1981; they were later collected to form The Gunslinger.

label: Stephen King — The Gunslinger
description: The first collected Dark Tower volume, assembled from five previously published magazine stories and released by Donald M. Grant in June 1982.

label: Stephen King — The Waste Lands
description: The third Dark Tower volume. Its title explicitly comes from T. S. Eliot’s The Waste Land, extending the series’ use of literary allusion, fragmentation, and ruined-world imagery.
